<FI> There is<Fi> no healing<WH03545> of thy bruise<WH07667>; thy wound<WH04347> is grievous<WH02470><WTH8737>: all that hear<WH08085><WTH8802> the bruit<WH08088> of thee shall clap<WH08628><WTH8804> the hands<WH03709> over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness<WH07451> passed<WH05674><WTH8804> continually<WH08548>? <RF>healing: Heb. wrinkling<Rf><CM>
